note: House LOD acceptance: close street-level view in the densest residential street >= 750 m from the rally route (where the old route-keyed LOD only built lean houses). Same pick for any build: deterministic from data.js. Camera is pinned (scene.onBeforeRender) 14 m behind the pick point at 1.7 m eye height, so before/after frame the same view regardless of chase-cam timing.

steps.eval: (async()=>{ const D=(await import(new URL('src/data.js', location.href).href)).WORLD_DATA; const R=[]; for(let i=0;i<=400;i++){ R.push(window.__proof.routePt(i/400)); } const cen=D.buildings.map(b=>{ let x=0,z=0; for(const q of b.pts){x+=q[0];z+=q[1];} return [x/b.pts.length,z/b.pts.length]; }); const rd=(x,z)=>{ let m=1e9; for(const p of R){ const d=Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z); if(d<m) m=d; } return m; }; let best=null; for(const r of D.roads){ if(r.hw!=='residential') continue; for(let i=0;i<r.pts.length-1;i++){ const [ax,az]=r.pts[i],[bx,bz]=r.pts[i+1]; const L=Math.hypot(bx-ax,bz-az); if(L<40) continue; const x=(ax+bx)/2, z=(az+bz)/2; const rdist=rd(x,z); if(rdist<750) continue; let n=0; for(const c of cen){ const dx=c[0]-x, dz=c[1]-z; if(dx*dx+dz*dz<3600) n++; } if(!best||n>best.n) best={n,x,z,h:Math.atan2(bx-ax,bz-az),rdist:Math.round(rdist)}; } } globalThis.__far=best; window.__proof.teleport(best.x,best.z,best.h); return best; })()

(()=>{ const L=globalThis.__lookdev, S=L.scene, b=globalThis.__far, prev=S.onBeforeRender; const fx=Math.sin(b.h), fz=Math.cos(b.h); S.onBeforeRender=function(r,s,c,...a){ if(prev) prev.call(this,r,s,c,...a); if(c.isPerspectiveCamera){ c.position.set(b.x-fx*14+fz*1.5, 1.7, b.z-fz*14-fx*1.5); c.lookAt(b.x+fx*30, 2.4, b.z+fz*30); c.updateMatrixWorld(); } }; return 'pinned'; })()
